reviews.comment: He just would not stop pushing a political agenda, it got old really fast and he didnt seem to get the memo

2 papers, 5 quizzes, 7-8 reflections. 1 presentation. Writing intensive. If you follow the rubric, you will get an A. I had alot of issues with my canvas, and he really cared and valued my WORK not due dates. You can tell he is talented and genuinely wants to read & hear about the topics.I'm a poli sci major but I would take him over and over again

His lectures were always engaging and informative. He is very accessible outside of class and you can definitely tell he cares. Attendance is mandatory, but he is willing to work with you under certain circumstances. I would take this class again- it was one of my favorites thus far. It definitely was a challenging course, but extremely enjoyable.

Professor Hessel-Mial was pretty good. He is a lenient grader and will give you feedback on drafts and help if you ask. You have to write 80% of the word count for drafts. Overall pretty good professor, and I recommend him for 104.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: He understands the creative writing brain - prompts are versatile and thought-provoking, he's lenient with word count limits and he doesn't require strict adherence to the prompt. Daily readings need to be done before class, but they tie in well and we have good discussions about how to apply them to our own writing. Accessible to all skill levels.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Participation matters--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Professor Hessel-Mial was a pretty cool professor, he cares about his students and getting to know them. There was a quite bit of reading to do but it is an English class so that should be no surprise, and his grading on papers or short reflections is also not too strict. Definitely recommend.

Dr. Michael is a nice guy! I learned a lot about creative writing through reading and practice. Class time needed more structure so we could actually do writing exercises in class. Often too much discussion of reading or the concept before we actually got to practice, if we had time. However, fun homework made an impressive portfolio! Solid choice.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: I took his creative writing class, and it was definitely very fun! I am not a very strong creative writer, but he really pulled out the best in his students. There's a lot of reading but as long as you skim, you're fine. The writing prompts are specific enough to give direction, but broad enough to allow for tons of creativity. Great prof!

Graded on reflections, rough and final drafts. Unclear grading criteria for zine project and does not post lecture slides on canvas. He's alright, just didn't take much away from the class. Feels like being retaught high school english. Work felt tedious and excessive for a level 100 course.
